edits.before: - Orianna Command: Shockwave: matchup-defining — The fight-flipping wombo — track the ball position like a second enemy. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Event Horizon (self-cage) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
